summary: Fixed two bugs in request-OTP flow: (1) moved rate-limit Record() before duplicate-challenge check so all attempts count toward rate limits, (2) added missing challenge persistence after OTP generation in RequestOtpUseCase, (3) fixed wrong test assertion (Assert.Equal(accountId, ChallengeId) — ChallengeId is a new GUID, not the AccountId), (4) changed rate limiter comparison from >= to > so pre-recorded attempts count correctly, (5) added public Clear() to InMemoryOtpRateLimiter replacing reflection hack, (6) applied same record-first ordering fix to OtpPolicyService. All 42 tests pass across Domain (41), Application (33), Architecture (1), Integration (16).
